easy.q: What number follows "Blink-" in the name of the pop-punk band behind "All the Small Things"?
easy.fact: The band first called itself just Blink, then added 182 to avoid a lawsuit.

easy.q: How many players does each team have on the field at once in an NFL game?
easy.fact: Teams that have 12 on the field get a 5-yard penalty.

easy.q: Juneteenth marks the day in 1865 when word of freedom reached enslaved people in Galveston, Texas. What day of June is it?
easy.fact: It became a federal holiday in 2021.

easy.q: At sea level, water boils at how many degrees Fahrenheit?
easy.fact: It freezes at 32 °F, exactly 180 degrees lower.

easy.q: How many March sisters are there in Louisa May Alcott’s Little Women?
easy.fact: They are Meg, Jo, Beth and Amy.

medium.q: How many seasons did the teen drama The O.C. run on Fox?
medium.fact: It aired from 2003 to 2007 and made Chrismukkah a thing.

medium.q: In what year did President Franklin D. Roosevelt sign the Social Security Act?
medium.fact: The first monthly check went out in 1940.

medium.q: How many U.S. states have no statewide sales tax?
medium.fact: They are Alaska, Delaware, Montana, New Hampshire and Oregon.

medium.q: What is the heaviest a bowling ball can legally weigh, in pounds?
medium.fact: There is no minimum weight; kids often roll 6-pound balls.

medium.q: How many weapons come with the classic board game Clue?
medium.fact: The original set had a candlestick, knife, lead pipe, revolver, rope and wrench.

hard.q: In Interstellar (2014), one hour on Miller’s planet equals how many years back on Earth?
hard.fact: The time slip comes from the planet orbiting close to a black hole.

hard.q: To the nearest year, how long did the supersonic Concorde carry paying passengers, from 1976 to 2003?
hard.fact: It crossed the Atlantic in about 3.5 hours.

hard.q: How tall is Guadalupe Peak, the highest point in Texas, in feet?
hard.fact: Its summit has a stainless-steel pyramid put up by American Airlines in 1958.

hard.q: How many career rushing yards did Emmitt Smith gain, the NFL record?
hard.fact: He played 13 of his 15 seasons with the Dallas Cowboys.
